g1|variants|cash sale.summary: The Cash Sale family handles counter-sales and immediate pickup scenarios where sales order creation triggers an instantaneous outbound delivery. Variants differ in whether the transaction is settled via order-related cash billing with receipt printout, delivery-related standard billing, digital/card payment settlement, or counter return refunding.

variants.name: Standard Cash Sale (BV)
variants.when_used: Customer orders, pays cash at counter, and receives goods immediately; sales order printout serves as invoice receipt.
variants.key_config: TVAK-AUTLF = 'X' (Immediate delivery); Output type RD03 assigned to order header; Billing type BV order-related.

variants.name: Rush Order (RO)
variants.when_used: Customer orders and takes goods immediately or requests immediate dispatch, but billing and invoicing occur later through normal AR cycles.
variants.key_config: TVAK-AUTLF = 'X' (Immediate delivery); Item category TAN billing relevance 'A'; Billing type F2 delivery-related.

variants.name: Walk-In Cash Sale with One-Time Customer (CPD)
variants.when_used: Unregistered counter customer pays cash and takes goods immediately; customer address is maintained directly on the order document.
variants.key_config: Account group CPD/CPDA assigned to one-time sold-to; TVAK-AUTLF = 'X'; Billing type BV with G/L cash clearing account.

variants.name: Counter Cash Sale with Payment Card / Digital Payments
variants.when_used: Counter customer takes goods immediately and settles via credit/debit card or contactless payment cleared via SAP digital payments add-on.
variants.key_config: Payment card plan activated in sales order; real-time authorization pre-requisite for immediate delivery creation; payment clearing at billing.

variants.name: Counter Cash Return (BV2)
variants.when_used: Customer returns goods to counter for immediate product restock and immediate cash refund or store credit payout.
variants.key_config: Order type BV2 configured with immediate return delivery; billing type BV2 generates credit memo with cash disbursement posting.

compare_groups.covers: Sales document type switches, item category determination, immediate delivery flags (TVAK-AUTLF), and shipping condition defaults.

compare_groups.covers: Outbound delivery type mapping, warehouse task creation, storage location assignment, and automated goods movement posting (Movement 601/651).

g1|core|cash sale|standard cash sale (bv.title: Standard Cash Sale (BV)
g1|core|cash sale|standard cash sale (bv.story: A customer walks up to an order desk, picks up products, pays right then, and leaves with both the goods and a printed receipt. In SAP S/4HANA, the sales clerk enters a Cash Sale order (document type BV), which immediately generates an outbound delivery in the background and prints an order-based receipt (output RD03) serving as the customer's invoice. Warehouse staff later post goods issue against the delivery, and finance runs order-related billing (billing type BV) to clear the cash balance without sending a second invoice to the customer.
g1|core|cash sale|standard cash sale (bv.why_business_needs_it: Trade counters and factory outlets require instantaneous counter pickup without making walk-in customers wait for asynchronous background delivery batches. It collapses sales order creation, picking notification, and customer invoicing documentation into a single customer-facing counter interaction while maintaining standard inventory and accounting integrity.

modules.role: Captures customer order lines, auto-triggers immediate outbound delivery creation, and prints the cash sale receipt.
modules.hands_off_to: LE-SHP (Shipping) via automatic background delivery creation.

modules.role: Tracks the warehouse staging and posts goods issue for the automatically generated delivery.
Generates the order-related billing document (type BV) against sales order quantities to recognize revenue.
modules.hands_off_to: FI-AR (Financial Accounting - Accounts Receivable) to clear cash settlement accounts.

modules.role: Receives the accounting document generated from billing type BV and offsets revenue against the cash clearing general ledger account.
modules.hands_off_to: CO-PA (Profitability Analysis) for profitability segment reporting.

prerequisites: Sales Organization, Distribution Channel, Division, and Plant mapped in Enterprise Structure (SPRO).
Shipping Point configured and assigned to Plant (OVXC / OVXD).
Standard Customer Master record created in the respective Sales Area (BP with FLCU01 / FLCU00).
Material Master created with Sales Org 1/2, Plant/Storage, and Accounting views (MM01).
Standard Pricing Condition Records maintained, e.g., Base Price PR00 (VK11).

config_steps.step: Define Sales Document Type BV for Cash Sales
config_steps.where: VOV8 -- SPRO > Sales and Distribution > Sales > Sales Documents > Sales Document Header > Define Sales Document Types
config_steps.values: Sales Doc Type BV: Category C, Dlv Type BV, Immed. Dlv X, Order Bill Type BV, Shipping Cond 10
config_steps.check: Open transaction VA01, enter order type BV, and verify that the screen loads with title 'Create Cash Sale: Initial Screen'.
config_steps.why: This step tells the system that a BV order must instantly trigger a delivery document and use order-related billing rather than waiting for shipping status. It enforces counter sales behavior directly from order entry.
config_steps.if_missing: The system will not generate an immediate outbound delivery upon order save, requiring manual shipping processing (Error V1 282 or delivery decoupling).
actions: Enter /nVOV8 in the command field and press Enter.
Select sales document type BV from the list or click New Entries (F5).
Maintain the Document Category as C (Order) and Sales Document Type as BV.
Set the Delivery Type to BV and enter Shipping Conditions as 10 (Immediate).
Set the Immediate Delivery flag to X (Create delivery immediately).
Maintain Order-Related Billing Type as BV and leave Delivery-Related Billing Type blank.
Click Save (Ctrl+S) and confirm the customizing transport request prompt.

fields.note: Standard Cash Sale document type identifier
Triggers Cash Sale delivery creation automatically
Enables automatic background outbound delivery upon order save
Must remain blank; cash sales bill directly from the order
Determines billing document type BV for the order invoice run

config_steps.step: Define Cash Sale Item Category BVN
config_steps.where: VOV7 -- SPRO > Sales and Distribution > Sales > Sales Documents > Sales Document Item > Define Item Categories
config_steps.values: Item Category BVN: Billing Relevance B, Pricing X, Sched. Lines Allowed X
config_steps.check: Display item category BVN in VOV7 and confirm Billing Relevance is set to B and Sched. Lines Allowed is flagged.
config_steps.why: This setting establishes that counter items can have delivery schedules and are billed based on the sales order quantity rather than the delivery note. It guarantees invoice creation matches what was paid at the desk.
config_steps.if_missing: The order lines cannot be scheduled for pickup or will incorrectly demand delivery-related billing, blocking document VF01 with error VF 044.
actions: Enter /nVOV7 in the command field and press Enter.
Locate item category BVN or click New Entries (F5).
Enter Item Category BVN and Description 'Cash Sale Item'.
Set Billing Relevance to B (Order-related billing status according to order quantity).
Set Pricing indicator to X (Pricing standard) and Check Credit Limit to blank.
Select Business Data permitted and Schedule Lines Allowed checkboxes.
Click Save (Ctrl+S) and assign the customizing transport request.

fields.note: Standard item category for cash sale items
Order-related billing based on confirmed order quantity
Permits business header override at item level
Mandatory to determine delivery quantities and dates

sap_refs.ref: SAP Help: Item Categories in Sales

config_steps.step: Assign Item Category Determination for Order Type BV
config_steps.where: VOV4 -- SPRO > Sales and Distribution > Sales > Sales Documents > Sales Document Item > Assign Item Categories
config_steps.values: Order Type BV + Item Cat Group NORM -> Default Item Category BVN
config_steps.check: In VA01, create a BV document and enter a standard NORM material; verify item category BVN defaults automatically on the item line.
config_steps.why: This step automatically assigns item category BVN whenever a standard stock material is placed in a cash sale order. It eliminates manual line item selection by counter staff.
config_steps.if_missing: The clerk will receive error V1 320 'Item category determination not defined' upon entering material lines in VA01.
actions: Enter /nVOV4 in the command field and press Enter.
Click New Entries (F5) on the toolbar.
In the Sales Document Type column, enter BV.
In the Item Category Group column, enter NORM.
Leave Usage and Item Category of Higher-Level Item columns blank.
In the Default Item Category column, enter BVN.
Click Save (Ctrl+S) and select your transport request.

fields.note: Standard stock item group from material master
Assigned cash sale default item category
Leave blank or specify alternate category if required

config_steps.step: Assign Schedule Line Category Determination to Item Category BVN
config_steps.where: VOV5 -- SPRO > Sales and Distribution > Sales > Sales Documents > Schedule Lines > Assign Schedule Line Categories
config_steps.screen_title: Change View "Schedule Line Category Determination": Overview
config_steps.values: Item Category BVN + MRP Type ND -> Default Schedule Line CP, Alternate CN
config_steps.check: Enter a line item in transaction VA01 under document type BV and verify on the Schedule Lines tab that category CP is populated.
config_steps.why: This configuration enables the system to schedule inventory availability and pass requirements directly to the warehouse. Without it, the cash sale cannot allocate goods from physical inventory.
config_steps.if_missing: Order items will show zero scheduled quantity and delivery creation will fail with error V1 261 'Item not relevant for delivery'.
actions: Enter /nVOV5 in the command field and press Enter.
Click New Entries (F5).
Enter Item Category BVN.
Enter MRP Type ND (or leave blank for non-MRP stock items).
Set Default Schedule Line Category to CP (MRP) or CN (No MRP).
Set Alternate Schedule Line Category to CN.
Click Save (Ctrl+S) and confirm the customizing transport.

fields.note: No planning or standard material MRP controller indicator
Default schedule line with stock transfer/availability check
Secondary schedule line category without stock check

config_steps.step: Define Outbound Delivery Type BV for Cash Sales
config_steps.where: 0VLK -- SPRO > Logistics Execution > Shipping > Deliveries > Define Delivery Types
config_steps.values: Delivery Type BV: Document Category J, Partner Proc LD, Auto Storage Location 1
config_steps.check: View delivery type BV in transaction 0VLK and verify that Category is J and Partner Procedure is LD.
config_steps.why: This step specifies the outbound delivery document attributes used exclusively by counter transactions. It structures shipping partner data and material movement parameters for the immediate handover.
config_steps.if_missing: The sales order save event will dump or reject delivery creation with error VL 149 'Delivery type BV not defined'.
actions: Enter /n0VLK in the command field and press Enter.
Select delivery type BV and double-click or click New Entries (F5).
Set Document Category to J (Delivery).
Set Default Partner Determination Procedure to LD (Delivery).
Ensure Route Determination is set or left blank depending on counter pickup requirements.
Maintain Document Type for Storage Location to Standard.
Click Save (Ctrl+S) and assign the transport request.

fields.note: Determine storage location automatically in delivery

config_steps.step: Configure Copy Control from Sales Document BV to Delivery Type BV
config_steps.where: VTLA -- SPRO > Logistics Execution > Shipping > Copying Control > Specify Copy Control for Deliveries
config_steps.values: Copy Control Target BV <- Source BV: Item BVN, Header Req 001, Item Req 101
config_steps.check: Save a BV order in VA01; inspect document flow via VA03 and verify that Outbound Delivery BV is immediately generated.
config_steps.why: Copy control defines the mapping rules that transfer sales header and item details into the outbound delivery note. It guarantees the shipping document inherits quantities, dates, and shipping points seamlessly.
config_steps.if_missing: The background delivery creation fails upon saving the order with message VL 014 'Copy control not defined for BV -> BV'.
actions: Enter /nVTLA in the command field and press Enter.
Click Display -> Change (Ctrl+F1).
Position cursor on Target Delivery Type BV and Source Sales Document Type BV; if missing, click New Entries.
Maintain Header Data with Order Requirement 001 (Header copy routine).
Double-click Item on the left navigation tree.
Enter Item Category BVN under delivery type BV and order type BV.
Set Copy Requirement to 101 or 001 and Data Transfer Item to 001.
Click Save (Ctrl+S) and confirm the transport request.

fields.note: Order line item category copied to delivery
Item delivery copy requirement for stock items

config_steps.step: Define Cash Sale Billing Type BV
config_steps.where: VOFA -- SPRO > Sales and Distribution > Billing > Billing Documents > Define Billing Types
config_steps.values: Billing Type BV: Category M, Tr. Group 7, Doc Type RV, Cancel Doc S1, Posting Block blank
config_steps.check: Verify billing type BV settings in VOFA and ensure accounting document type RV and transaction group 7 are assigned.
config_steps.why: This step defines the invoice structure for back-office settlement of cash sales. It ensures internal accounting documents post to ledger RV without issuing an external invoice to the customer.
config_steps.if_missing: Executing transaction VF01 against the cash order will fail with error VF 008 'Billing type BV is not defined'.
actions: Enter /nVOFA in the command field and press Enter.
Select billing document type BV and double-click or click New Entries (F5).
Set Document Category to M (Invoice).
Set Transaction Group to 7 (Billing document).
Set Document Type to RV (Billing Doc Transfer).
Set Cancellation Billing Type to S1.
Leave Posting Block unchecked to allow automatic FI posting.
Click Save (Ctrl+S) and assign the customizing transport.

fields.note: Accounting document type for sales ledger interface
Unchecked to ensure automated posting to finance

config_steps.step: Maintain Copy Control from Sales Document BV to Billing Type BV
config_steps.where: VTFA -- SPRO > Sales and Distribution > Billing > Billing Documents > Maintain Copying Control for Billing Documents
config_steps.values: Copy Control Target BV <- Source BV: Item BVN, Req 002, Bill Qty F, Pricing Source E
config_steps.check: Execute VF01 with a saved BV order number; verify the billing items and values populate directly from the order lines.
config_steps.why: Copy control instructs the billing engine to read data straight from the sales order rather than the delivery note. It guarantees that the accounting document exactly mirrors the counter price accepted by the customer.
config_steps.if_missing: Billing creation in VF01 fails with error VF 044 'Copy control is not maintained for target BV and source BV'.
actions: Enter /nVTFA in the command field and press Enter.
Switch to Change mode (Ctrl+F1).
Position on Target Billing Type BV and Source Sales Doc BV; if missing, click New Entries.
In Header details, set Copying Requirements to 001 (Header copy).
Double-click Item on the navigation pane and select Item Category BVN.
Set Copy Requirement to 002 (Order-related billing).
Set Billing Quantity to F (Order quantity less invoiced quantity).
Set Pricing Source to E (Adopt pricing conditions unchanged).
Click Save (Ctrl+S) and confirm the customizing transport.

fields.note: Order quantity minus already invoiced quantity
Copies pricing from sales order without recalculation

config_steps.step: Configure Output Type RD03 for Cash Sale Receipt
config_steps.where: V/30 -- SPRO > Sales and Distribution > Basic Functions > Output Determination > Output Determination Using the Condition Technique > Maintain Output Determination for Sales Documents > Maintain Output Types
config_steps.values: Output Type RD03: Access Seq 0002, Medium 1 (Print), Dispatch Time 4 (Immediate)
config_steps.check: Verify in V/30 that RD03 has Dispatch Time set to 4 and Transmission Medium set to 1.
config_steps.why: This setting configures the receipt printout triggered from the sales order to act as the legal invoice for the customer. It ensures the paper receipt prints instantaneously at the cash desk upon saving.
config_steps.if_missing: The desk clerk will have to manually trigger printing or the customer will leave without a valid tax receipt.
actions: Enter /nV/30 in the command field and press Enter.
Position cursor on Output Type RD03 (Cash Sale Invoice) and double-click.
Verify Access Sequence is set to 0002 (Sales Organization / Order Type).
In the General Data tab, ensure Access to Conditions checkbox is selected.
In the Default Values tab, select Transmission Medium 1 (Print Output).
Set Dispatch Time to 4 (Send immediately (when saving the application)).
In Processing Routines, check that standard print program RVADOCO1 (or PDF equivalent) and form are assigned.
Click Save (Ctrl+S) and assign the transport request.

fields.note: Search sequence based on sales org and doc type
Enables condition record evaluation via VV11
Print output on local counter printer
Immediate print triggered upon order save

config_steps.step: Assign Output Type RD03 to Sales Output Determination Procedure
config_steps.where: V/08 -- SPRO > Sales and Distribution > Basic Functions > Output Determination > Output Determination Using the Condition Technique > Maintain Output Determination for Sales Documents > Maintain Output Determination Procedure
config_steps.values: Procedure V10000: Step 30, Counter 1, Output Type RD03, Requirement 002
config_steps.check: In transaction V/08, display procedure V10000 and confirm RD03 is listed under Control Data.
config_steps.why: Output determination procedures group valid print and communication types for a sales transaction. Without this assignment, the sales order header cannot discover the RD03 receipt condition.
config_steps.if_missing: The sales order will save without generating an output record, showing 'No output determined' in VA02/VA03.
actions: Enter /nV/08 in the command field and press Enter.
Locate Sales Document Procedure V10000 (Standard Order) and double-click Control Data.
Click New Entries (F5).
Enter the next available Step number (e.g., 30) and Counter 1.
Enter Condition Type RD03.
In the Requirement column, enter 002 (Order confirmed/complete) or leave blank for immediate determination.
Click Save (Ctrl+S) and confirm the transport request.

fields.note: Header output determination procedure for sales orders
Output type assigned to the procedure
Only executes output if order is technically complete

config_steps.step: Maintain Output Condition Record for Cash Sale Receipt RD03
config_steps.where: VV11 -- SAP Easy Access > Logistics > Sales and Distribution > Master Data > Output > Sales Document > Create
config_steps.screen_title: Create Condition Records (Cash Sale): Fast Entry
config_steps.values: Condition Record RD03: Sales Org 1010, Order BV, Partner SP, Medium 1, Time 4, Device LOCL
config_steps.check: In VA01, create and save a BV order for Sales Org 1010; check Extras > Output > Header > Edit and confirm RD03 is green (processed).
config_steps.why: This master record tells the system which printer and partner to send the cash sale receipt to when an order is created. It automates physical ticket generation at the counter.
config_steps.if_missing: The sales order will save without producing a printed receipt on the desk printer, requiring manual print issuing in VA02.
actions: Enter /nVV11 in the command field and press Enter.
Enter Output Type RD03 and press Enter.
Select key combination 'Sales Organization / Order Type' if prompted.
Enter Sales Organization 1010 and Order Type BV.
Enter Partner Function SP (Sold-to party).
Set Transmission Medium to 1 (Print Output) and Dispatch Time to 4 (Send immediately).
Select the row and click Communication (Shift+F5).
Enter Output Device (e.g., LP01 or LOCL) and select Print Immediately.
Click Back (F3) and click Save (Ctrl+S).

config_steps.step: Maintain Revenue Account Determination for Cash Clearing
config_steps.where: VKOA -- SPRO > Sales and Distribution > Basic Functions > Account Assignment/Costing > Revenue Account Determination > Assign G/L Accounts
config_steps.screen_title: Change View "Account Determination: Assign G/L Accounts": Overview
config_steps.values: VKOA KOFI: Chart of Accts YCOA, Sales Org 1010, Key EVV -> G/L Account 11001000
config_steps.check: Execute VF01 to bill a BV sales order; verify that the accounting document releases without error and debits Cash Clearing.
config_steps.why: This mapping directs invoice debits away from regular accounts receivable and into a cash clearing account since payment was already collected at the counter. It prevents customer open items from aging on the balance sheet.
config_steps.if_missing: Releasing the billing document to accounting fails with error VF 051 'Account determination error: account could not be determined'.
actions: Enter /nVKOA in the command field and press Enter.
Select Table 001 (Cust.Grp/MaterialGrp/AcctKey) or Table 002 (Chart of Accounts/Sales Org/Acct Key).
Click Choose (F2) or New Entries (F5).
Enter Application V (Sales/Distribution) and Condition Type KOFI.
Enter Chart of Accounts YCOA and Sales Organization 1010.
Enter Account Key EVV (Cash settlement / clearing) or ERL (Revenue).
Specify the corresponding Cash Clearing G/L Account (e.g., 11001000).
Click Save (Ctrl+S) and assign the customizing transport request.

fields.note: Cash on hand / settlement balance sheet account
